page.overview:
Who is Otto Boffin?

Otto Boffin, also known as Otto the Fat, was a Hobbit of the Shire.

Otto was the only child of Bosco Boffin and his unnamed wife. He married Lavender Grubb and they had four children: Hugo, Uffo, Rollo, and Primrose Boffin. He died in TA 2900 (SR 1300) at the age of eighty-eight.
